title.narrative: Raising Civil VOICES: Acting Together for Inclusive Democracy, Peace and Justice in South Sudan

description.narrative: ¿Raising Civil VOICES¿ is a three-year EU-funded project designed to boost the ability of South Sudanese citizens at large, and youth and women especially, to exercise their civic rights to meaningfully participate in democratic and electoral processes in South Sudan. The main intended beneficiaries of the project are civil society actors across all ten states.
